run_sample_mjhq: run the MetaQuery pipeline to generate images from MJHQ dataset prompts and save them to an output directory
run_sample_metaquery: run the sample_metaquery function to generate images from text prompts using a loaded MetaQueryPipeline
run_main: run the main function to load a checkpoint, read dataset prompts, and batch-generate images
review_sample_metaquery: review the sample_metaquery function that calls the pipeline with caption, guidance scale, and inference steps
review_main: review the main function that loads checkpoints, reads JSON datasets, and saves generated images as PNGs
